description: This file defines the ParentExpression class in Twig, representing a node for parent block references in Twig templates. It includes constructor and compile methods to generate PHP code for rendering parent blocks.

classes.name: ParentExpression
classes.description: Represents a parent node in Twig templates, used to render or yield parent blocks during template inheritance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ParentExpression with a block name and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for rendering the parent block, either yielding from it or rendering it directly, depending on the 'output' attribute.
